tei:div.tei:p: 303)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i spyi bskang nyams chags rang grol dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye:

sngon smon las 'phro dus 'dzoms pa'i: skal bzang skyes bu mi mchog rnams: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: brten nas nyams chags bskang ba dang: rim gnyis dngos grub thob pa'i thabs: spyi bskang dngos grub char 'bebs bstan: sa ma ya: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid snod bcud rang byung phyi yi tshogs: 'byor tshogs 'dod yon longs spyod nang gi tshogs: mnyam sbyor zag med bde chen gsang ba'i tshogs: mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor spel: sku gsum zhing khams rgya mtsho khyab pa yi: bla med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan bdun gyis brlabs: de nas bskang ba dngos ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma skyes rnam dag chos dbyings zhing khams nas: dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: nges pa lnga ldan lhun grub gzhal yas nas: brda brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i= mi mjed 'jig rten dag pa'i zhing khams nas: snyan brgyud rig 'dzin= spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng 304)nas: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i= dbang dang dngos grub gdams pa'i klong mdzod nas: bka' brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i= mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug= thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lta ba mtha' bral yangs pas bskang: sgom pa zang thal chen pos bskang: spyod pa spang blang bral bas bskang: 'bras bu ye grol chen pos bskang: mnyam nyid mnyam rdzogs klong du bskang: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor gtso mchog khyab bdag kun bzang mo: chos sku'i mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs mdzad rnal 'byor ma: longs sku'i mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs= gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i spyi rje mo: rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal= brgyud gsum chu bo gcig 'dres pad+ma 'byung: rigs bdag mtsho skyes rdo rje'i=

sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal: gu ru thod phreng sde lnga'i thugs= ye shes lnga yi sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya'i gar: dbyings kyi yum chen lnga yi= gang 'dul thabs kyis mdzad pa sna tshogs ston: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i= chad med bzhi yis 305)'gro rnams bde la sbyor: sgo skyong ḍā ki sde bzhi'i= bka' dang dam tshig gnyen gyis bsdus pa yi: gnas yul zhing skyong dam can= thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi mchod yid 'ong rnam lngas bskangs: nang mchod 'dod yon drug gis bskangs: gsang mchod sman gtor rak+tas= yang gsang sbyor sgrol mchod pas= dga' bzhi bde chen rol pas= thugs dam dgyes bskang dngos grub stsol: gzhan yang lha mi'i 'dod yon dpal: zag med bde chen bskyed pa'i rdzas: dza gad skyems dang māṃ sa ta: 'byor tshogs longs spyod tshogs kyis= bza' bca' btung sogs bldag gzhib zas: dkar gsum mngar gsum ro mchog dang: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: dngos yid ting 'dzin dag pa'i rdzas: bskang ba'i mchod pa bla na med: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig nyon shes sgrib dbang gis: don dam spros bral chos sku'i zhal ma mthong: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i klong du bzod par gsol: 306)sems kyi rang bzhin ye nas stong pa che: mtha' bral lta ba klong chen yangs pa'i mkha': ma rig dbang gis stong nyid don ma rtogs: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang gang 'gal ba: sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: mi 'gyur mi 'gags rang gsal dgongs pa'i babs: rig stong brjod bral blo 'das 'od gsal ngang: ma rig dbang gis gnyug ma'i don ma rtogs: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang= sprul pa= rang byung rang shar ye grol chos nyid klong: blang dor ris med kun bzang chos kyi dbyings:

gnas lugs don gyi spyod pa'i gnas tshul rnams: ma rig dbang gis gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bsgribs: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs= sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i= 'khor 'das gnyis med rig pa byang chub sems: sku dang ye shes yon tan lhun gyis grub: sku gsum rig pa gzhir rdzogs 'bras bu'i don: ma rig dbang gis ji bzhin don ma rtogs: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs= sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i= dag grol gnyis ldan 'gyur med chos sku'i dbyings: sku lnga gsung lnga thugs lnga yon tan lnga: phrin las lnga sogs ye shes lhun grub dbyings: ma rig dbang gis gzhan bzung nongs pa kun: 307)las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs= sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i= gzhan yang sgo gsum bag med 'khrul dbang gis: so thar byang sems gsang sngags gnyen po yi: sdom dang bslab pa dam tshig la sogs pa: 'gal zhig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags: mi 'chab mi sbed slan chad sdom par bgyi: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang 'gal ba gang: rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: mi sgrib tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs: āḥ 'dir brtson skyes bu gang su dag: nyams chags kun kyang sor chud nas: tshe 'di'i rkyen zhi nyams rtogs 'phel: dgongs pa mi 'gyur gnad rtogs nas: rim gnyis dngos grub 'bad med thob: tshe 'dir rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yis: rjes bzung don gnyis 'byung bar nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang gter grogs mi 'gyur rdo rjes bka' bskul ma ldog tsam du kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// 308)
